title: The Moon Moves Into Nancy's Spare Room
skyStory: Big news on the mountain. The moon, seventeen percent lit and carrying far too many boxes, has moved into Capricorn, Nancy's sign. Saturn is giving it the tour: here is the good chair, here is the window with the view, please use a coaster. The moon has never been this tidy in its life. It is also Friday the thirteenth, which Saturn finds frankly beneath it.

reading: With the moon off visiting Nancy's side of the map, your job today is caretaker. Keep the cabin fire going, keep the kettle full, keep the jokes coming. Somebody near you is having a heavier day than they let on. You will notice it by the way they hold their mug with both hands.

Offer one small kindness without announcing it. Then, and this is the hard part, let someone do one small kindness for you without immediately trying to repay it. If someone holds a door, walk through it. Do not race ahead to hold the next door. The universe is keeping score, and today it only counts the doors you walk through.
joel.mission: Switch the onyx to your right wrist at lunchtime and send the mountain one silent cheer for her big moon day.
joel.omen: A black cat crossing your path from left to right. Excellent luck, actually. The cat insists, and it has paperwork.
joel.stoneWhy: clear light for a clear head
joel.elementWhy: grounded so the mountain can shine

reading: The moon is staying in your guest room for two days and it brought a housewarming gift: everything you touch today goes a little more smoothly than it should. Doors open before you push. The printer behaves. A sentence you have been chewing on for a week finally comes out exactly right.

Saturn, your ruler, is in its cozy-sweater era and wants you to enjoy this instead of auditing it. The [[Knight of Pentacles]] is not asking you to earn this one. Accept the easy day. Life Path 11 knows a gift when it sees one; the trick is unwrapping it without reading the instructions first.
nancy.mission: Sit in the best seat of any room you enter today, as if the moon is paying your rent.
nancy.omen: A perfectly stacked pile of something, firewood or books or plates. The mountain is pleased with your work.
nancy.stoneWhy: earth stone for the earth sign

together.text: Tonight, each name one place that feels like home that is not a house. A certain bench, a bend in the road, a smell. Trade them. The moon, newly moved in and slightly homesick itself, will be eavesdropping and taking notes for its own housewarming.

game.intro: The moon just moved into Nancy's spare room and it is making noise up there. Contestants, warm up your mouths.
game.prompt: The sound of someone settling into a creaky old house at night: floorboard, radiator, door, your call.
